answer: Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the terrace of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
